Container.Name: mcp-tacobell
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects Claude.ai to Taco Bell. Ask Claude to find your local Taco Bell, browse the menu, build a cart, and place a pickup order — all from a conversation. Uses your tacobell.com account credentials to authenticate and charge your saved payment method.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port the MCP server listens on. Use this port when configuring Claude.ai remote MCP. Defaults to 3002 to avoid conflicts with mcp-ynab (3000) and mcp-mediamanager (3001).

Config.Name: Taco Bell Email
Config.Description: The email address for your tacobell.com account.

Config.Name: Taco Bell Password
Config.Description: The password for your tacobell.com account.

Config.Name: Default Store ID
Config.Description: Optional: pre-set your local Taco Bell store ID so you don't have to find it every time. Use the tacobell_find_stores tool to discover your store ID, then paste it here.

Config.Name: MCP Auth Token (Secret)
Config.Description: A secret token to protect your MCP endpoint. Set any long random string here and use the same value when configuring Claude.ai. Leave blank to disable auth (not recommended if exposed to the internet).

Config.Name: MCP Client ID
Config.Description: OAuth client ID used alongside the auth token. You can leave this as 'mcp-tacobell'.
